source_snapshot.items: use agt tool change bandwidth and speed
source_snapshot.procedure: At 25C, set AGT PCIe link speed values 1..4 with status checks, then malformed `pciekinkwidth` width values 1,2,4,8,16 with inconsistent command paths and status checks.
source_snapshot.criteria: Gen speed changes without dmesg error; no width PASS/FAIL rule.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL summarizes link training but does not resolve malformed syntax, value mapping, width oracle, temperature control or baseline restoration.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires corrected vendor syntax, speed mapping, supported width expected states, 25C sensor/tolerance and transactional restore.

old_problem: Width commands are malformed and Criteria cover only speed although Procedure changes both speed and width. Requested values are not necessarily negotiated states, and no target BDF, 25C oracle or baseline restore is defined.
disposition_reason: Correcting `pciekinkwidth`, missing `./` paths or speed-value mappings would guess OEM command semantics prohibited by ED-03. The absent width Expected Result and baseline restoration are core acceptance/safety gaps, not runtime identifiers. Project/vendor authority must approve them before link retraining.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row232 all18 XLSX cells and history2836.
Preserved every requested speed/width state and the malformed source rather than silently correcting it.
Required stable BDF, negotiated readback, 25C control, error deltas and final restoration. No AGT/retrain or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: 25C GPU PCIe speed/width retraining pending AGT syntax and width oracle
test_case.purpose: At an approved stable 25C condition, exercise every supported requested PCIe generation and lane width on the exact GPU link, verify negotiated state/error health after each transition, and restore the original link state.
required_package: Vendor-approved corrected AGT speed/width/status syntax and mapping of speed values 1..4 to generations
Supported width requests 1/2/4/8/16 with expected negotiated-state PASS/FAIL rule
Authoritative 25C sensor/location, tolerance and soak/stability requirement
Recorded baseline speed/width/ASPM, transition timeout, AER abort and restore/OOB recovery
test_case.test_command: Do not execute malformed source commands. After vendor approval, bind the exact physical link to current BDF, record baseline and 25C stability, request each approved speed and width in source order using documented syntax, read back the same link's negotiated state plus AER/dmesg after every transition, then restore and verify the baseline. Do not treat request acceptance as negotiated success.
test_case.expected_result: Every approved requested generation/width negotiates to its documented expected state within timeout at 25C, no new link/AER/GPU error occurs, and the exact baseline is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS is prohibited until corrected syntax, value mappings and width oracle are approved. Speed-only evidence cannot cover the source width transitions.
safety_gate: Link retraining requires explicit maintenance approval, stable BDF mapping and OOB access.
Confirm 25C at the approved sensor/tolerance before and during transitions.
Capture baseline and restore even after partial failure.
Abort on link loss, wrong BDF, unsupported state, AER growth, GPU/XID or restore failure; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Per-transition request, negotiated speed/width and AER/dmesg evidence
Final baseline restore and GPU/link/platform health
test_case.recovery: Stop at first unexpected transition, restore the recorded speed/width/ASPM through the approved command, verify link/BDF/GPU health and use OOB recovery if needed. Do not continue to another state or retry automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Malformed width/status commands and speed-only Criteria leave executable syntax and width acceptance materially unresolved.

blocked.reason: Static review is complete; execution is prohibited until command semantics, width oracle and restore contract are approved.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Approve AGT syntax/mappings, width expected states, target BDF, 25C control and baseline recovery.
pending.owner: AMD AGT/vendor, PCIe/platform and thermal owners.
pending.unlock_condition: Supply vendor-corrected commands and a complete speed/width acceptance plus restoration contract.

project_authority: AGT syntax/value mappings and platform-supported widths are vendor/project-specific and cannot be guessed.
